title: A residents' noticeboard for a city of complexes
summary: Show each resident the posts from their own building and area, quickly and without noise.
context: Hebbal Homes wants to add a noticeboard. A committee posts a water shutdown, a resident sells a cycle, and a neighbouring complex warns about a theft. Each person should see their own building first, then their complex, then the area.
There are 400,000 residents, and traffic spikes when an urgent notice goes out, as everyone opens the app at once. A wrongly delivered post from a private complex would be a real breach of trust.
must_handle: An urgent notice reaches everyone in the complex within a minute.
A resident who has moved out stops seeing posts at once.
A complex of 5,000 flats and one of 20 both feel quick.
A person can report a post, and a committee can take it down everywhere.
The feed opens fast on a spike of a whole complex at once.
show_in_answer: How a post reaches the feeds it belongs in.
What is computed on write and what on read, and why.
What is cached and how it is invalidated when someone moves out or a post is removed.
How an urgent notice is handled differently.
